summary: Frontend-only validation for two small features on GestorCred: (1) dynamic document.title per route; (2) Expandir/Recolher tudo button on /consultas. Both features work correctly. Used only 1 CPF search as instructed.
tests_performed: Landing (/) title = 'GestorCred - Sistema #1 de Gestão de Empréstimos | Software Controle Crédito Pessoal | Cobrança PIX Automática' ✅
consulta-toggle-todas button present, initial text 'Expandir tudo' with 0 open sections ✅
1st click on toggle-todas → text becomes 'Recolher tudo' and all 6 sections of Cadastral category open ✅
2nd click on toggle-todas → text back to 'Expandir tudo' and all sections close (0 open) ✅
Individual toggle (consulta-secao-toggle-rgHistorico) opens only that single section (1 open) ✅
Switching to different category (consulta-cat-contatos) → button correctly shows 'Expandir tudo' with 0 open in new category (state per-category reflected) ✅
Switching back to consulta-cat-cadastral preserves previous open state (1 section still open) ✅
context_for_next_testing_agent: PageTitle.js maps route prefixes to titles and preserves long SEO title only on '/'. Consultas Expandir/Recolher works per current category (catCorrente.secoes). Only 1 CPF call spent from LosDados quota during this iteration.
